Preserve each source identity, object count, palette, pixel-art ink/texture, proportions and distinctive construction details. Use one complete object per row, in the exact listed row order. The whole connected object must fit each cell with transparent margins; no clipping, neighboring cells, stray labels, shadows, guides or scenery. Six columns by four rows, square atlas, evenly sized cells and gutters. Keep each object pose/orientation fixed across views; opposite views must reverse landmark ordering as physical cameras require. Keep a readable pixel-art look matching the references.
Row order: (1) iron-trains-riveted-carriage-metal-inner-corner, (2) iron-trains-riveted-carriage-metal-endcap-northwest.
Preserve the Iron Trains red enamel, riveted gold/yellow brackets and dark iron outlines; no unrelated carriage panels or neighboring parts. Opposing views reverse the fixed corner landmarks; do not force three caps separated in every view when camera occlusion is natural. Row 2 is one compact square riveted cap/block only: no L-arm or neighbor. FRONT/REAR/RIGHT/LEFT show coherent short block side faces with gold riveted rim and red inset; TOP/BOTTOM show compact matching square cap faces with four corner fasteners. Keep equal overall dimensions across six views and the same center anchor.
